verdict.rationale: A LiteLLM maintainer confirmed the proxy supports streaming the same way as the openai-python SDK (litellm-comm-13). The docs describe a single completion() interface and OpenAI-format responses across providers (litellm-docs-1, litellm-docs-2, litellm-gh-1), which supports streaming through one gateway regardless of provider. Missing for 10: first-party streaming documentation, explicit evidence that token-by-token streaming works for every provider, and independent hands-on corroboration.
